rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns enforcement of agricultural manure transport documentation (VDM) and phosphate/nitrogen manure sample manipulation under the Uitvoeringsregeling Meststoffenwet and Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet, which are non-water regulatory disputes under the protocol.
